about_short_description.short_description: Truora offers a technology paltform to simplify and automate user interactions across digital channels.

product.name: Digital Identity Validation
product.description: A service that verifies user identity through document validation, facial recognition, and contact verification to prevent fraud and comply with regulations.

product.name: TruChecks Background Verification
product.description: An online background check service that accesses national and international criminal, judicial, and penal records to assess user risk.

product.name: WhatsApp Chatbots with AI Integration
product.description: Automated chatbots on WhatsApp that handle customer service, marketing, and sales conversations, enhanced with AI for personalized and scalable interactions.

product.name: ZapSign Electronic Signature
product.description: A digital signature platform that enables the creation, sending, and collection of legally valid electronic signatures through multiple channels.

product.name: WhatsApp and HubSpot Integration
product.description: A connector that integrates WhatsApp Business with HubSpot CRM to automate user interactions and synchronize customer data.

product.name: TruCode Programming Scholarship Program
product.description: A virtual scholarship program offering web programming courses for women in Latin America to promote inclusion in technology fields.
